title: V3 D0 盈亏 TOP30 路径形态审计
primary_question: 抛开主题/行业指数，盈利 TOP30 与亏损 TOP30 在买入过热、持仓 MFE/MAE、回吐、均线破坏和排名痕迹上有什么差异？
primary_variable: read-only per-trade price path morphology over V3 stock closed trades
fixed_assumptions: stock_alpha_core closed trades only; ETF sleeve excluded
no runtime, NAV, signal, pool, ranking, execution, or exit-rule changes
theme and industry indices are not used as triggers in D0

evidence.note: human report for D0 trade path morphology audit
per-trade price path metrics for all closed stock trades

key_findings: Closed stock trades audited: 388; path available: 388.
Profit TOP30 avg MFE/giveback: 97.92%/31.02%; Loss TOP30 avg MFE/giveback: 8.13%/26.83%.
Profit TOP30 avg pre-entry 20d / loss TOP30 avg pre-entry 20d: 39.25%/54.49%.

decision.reason: Use D0 morphology to decide whether next research should target entry confirmation, profit giveback, or risk-off timing.

next_actions: Separate loss TOP30 into never-worked vs gave-back-winners.
Check whether sell warnings appeared many days before exit.
Design one follow-up shadow only after the dominant failure mode is clear.
